title: Flow & Execute
notes: FLOW: strike in a steady rhythm to build up to 5 Flow stacks. Each stack adds damage and charges crystals faster. Mashing or getting hit breaks it.
EXECUTE: enemies below 15% HP get a gold health bar. One strike finishes them instantly with a bonus crystal.
Live hints teach Flow and Execute during battles.
Rebalanced around the new mechanics: tougher enemies, slower early levels, bosses less of a wall, Gate D a bit harder and Gate C a bit easier.
